cards.title: Surviving Six Weeks of Summer Holidays
cards.body: Parents face the annual challenge of finding affordable fun during school breaks. Scientists reveal that unstructured play, like orangutans arrange for their offspring, offers proven health benefits for children of all ages.

cards.title: Breaking the Cycle of Childhood Trauma
cards.body: Most parents carry unresolved wounds from their own childhoods that can trigger unhealthy patterns. By understanding our personal triggers, we can prevent passing trauma down to our children.

cards.title: Can We Teach Children to Be Kinder?
cards.body: Recent research confirms that kindness in children can be actively taught and cultivated. The benefits extend far beyond kindness itself, positively impacting multiple areas of child development.

cards.title: How Early Family Trauma Shapes Adult Relationships
cards.body: Unresolved childhood wounds create lasting emotional vulnerabilities in romantic partnerships. Understanding these patterns helps parents break cycles and build healthier family dynamics.

cards.title: Why Shame Matters in Adolescent Mental Health
cards.body: Shame is a significant but underestimated driver of suicidal ideation in teenagers. Parents and caregivers can help by creating safe spaces where adolescents feel accepted.

cards.title: Fathers Listening Without Defending Heals Old Wounds
cards.body: When fathers listen to their children without justifying themselves, deep emotional healing becomes possible. These moments of genuine attention can transform family relationships across generations.

cards.title: Streets Closing So Children Can Safely Play
cards.body: Leeds is temporarily closing streets to traffic, creating safe spaces for children to play outdoors. This initiative benefits both kids' physical activity and community well-being.
